purpose: Bounded extension routes for the canonical onchain Market Data registry. Kept separate so the proven v0.15 registry remains byte-stable while the new reusable Uniswap V2 historical TWAP mechanism is production-proven.

route.provenance: Official Olas OLAS token and protocol-owned OLAS/WETH Uniswap V2 pair. Read-only cumulative-price historical TWAP from two block-pinned pair states, composed with same-cycle ETH/USD. No updatePrice transaction, keeper dependency, get_dy, reserve spot price, or execution authority.
